result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make the consequences of our choices impossible to ignore—not through punishment, but through clarity.

If every person could feel, even briefly, how their actions land on others, cruelty would become harder to rationalize. Indifference would become less comfortable. Systems built on exploitation, dehumanization, or apathy would lose their easiest fuel: abstraction.

The world would change because people would no longer be able to treat other people as unreal.
